data.gender_notes: Nadrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The act of calling to prayer or invoking Allah (swt). The name Nadrah carries the meaning “Call to prayer, invocation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nadrah usually hope their child will grow to embody call to prayer, invocation and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Nadrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Call to prayer, invocation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadrah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: ندرہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو خوبصورتی اور روعة کو ظاہر کرتی ہے
